name: Loki
note: Polygons in the rest pose (A1) pixels. Style-locked sheets. The uninvited guest: any chair, drawn facing right and mirrored. The master is the rest pose's OWN head (loki_face/loki_master.png). Every pose but rest a whole-figure frame with its own drawn head, placed ('reg') by the bottom-left corner of its drawn felt. His golden game piece stands on the felt by his right hand: part of that forearm's piece at rest, a props box in every frame.

what.A1: Rest: forearms on the table's edge, hands apart, the golden game piece by his right hand
what.A2: Peek: right hand cupped low over the felt
what.A3: Check: two fingers tap the felt
what.A4: Call: right hand pushes forward along the felt
what.A5: Bet: leans in, right hand pushed well forward
what.A6: Fold: a careless flick of the right hand
what.B1: All in: both hands push forward together, a sly grin
what.B2: Show: right hand turns palm up
what.B3: Big win: both fists raised, laughing
what.B4: TELL bluffing: fingertips touching the stitch-scars on his lips
what.B5: Rubs his chin with a knuckle (decoy for the scars)
what.B6: Rolls a fish scale across his knuckles
what.C1: Counts the players with one finger
what.C2: Glances up at the ceiling, listening (decoy for the eyes)
what.C3: Hums, eyes half closed, head tilted
what.C4: Turns the golden game piece over in his fingers
what.C5: A full, easy smile (decoy for the half smile)
what.C6: Arrive: taking the chair, looking round, amused
what.D1: Talking: one hand turning in the air
what.D2: Facing a big bet: chin on his hand
what.D3: Lost a pot: a shrug, palms up
what.D4: Crushing loss: jaw tight, staring at the table
what.D5: Heads up: leaning in on both forearms

rest.what: his right forearm, cuff and hand, and the game piece by it
his left forearm, cuff and hand
